brief: Oasis Town kit: an isometric corner cafe diorama on its own slab, same projection, light (2,-1,3), scale and slab style as oasis-town.mjs: two-storey cafe with a striped awning, outdoor tables with umbrellas, potted plants, a bicycle, a chalkboard sign, string lights at night. Knobs: awning/umbrella colours with roles, season, time (day/dusk/night with lit windows), tables count, seed. price 8

Oasis Town kit: an isometric shrine garden diorama on a slab matching oasis-town.mjs: a vermilion torii gate, stone lanterns, a small shrine hall with a dark tiled roof, a gravel path, cherry trees, a stone fence. Knobs: gate colour (primary role), roof colour, season (spring blossom/summer/autumn/winter snow), time with lantern glow at night, lantern count, seed. price 9

Oasis Town kit: an isometric food-truck plaza diorama matching oasis-town.mjs: 2-4 food trucks with serving hatches and striped awnings, picnic benches, string lights, a few cubic trees and planters on a paved slab. Knobs: truck colours via roles, truck count, time (night lights), season, seed. price 8

Oasis Town kit: an isometric little train station diorama matching oasis-town.mjs: a platform with a canopy, a short two-car train on rails, a ticket booth, benches, a station clock pole, a vending machine. Knobs: train colour (primary role), canopy colour, cars count, time with lit windows, season, seed. price 10

Oasis Town kit: an isometric park diorama matching oasis-town.mjs: a round fountain built from boxes and water quads, paths, benches, lamp posts, many cubic trees, a playground slide. Knobs: tree colours by season, water colour, path colour, time with glowing lamps, tree density, seed. price 7

Oasis Town kit: an isometric harbor pier diorama matching oasis-town.mjs: wooden pier planks over water, two small boats with sails, a lighthouse, crates and barrels, a fish shop with an awning. Knobs: water colour, boat/sail colours via roles, lighthouse stripes, time (lighthouse beam at night), season, seed. price 10

Oasis Town kit: an isometric night-market alley diorama matching oasis-town.mjs: a row of small stalls with cloth canopies, hanging paper lanterns, crates of produce, a noodle cart, warm glowing light. Knobs: canopy colours via roles, lantern colour, stall count, time (best at night, also dusk/day), seed. price 9

Oasis Town kit: an isometric campus quad diorama matching oasis-town.mjs: a brick hall with a clock tower, lawn with crossing paths, trees, benches, bikes in a rack, a banner on the hall. Knobs: brick and banner colours via roles, season, time, tower height, seed. price 9

Oasis Town kit: an isometric modern office tower block diorama matching oasis-town.mjs: 2-3 glass towers of different heights with window grids, a plaza with planters, a coffee kiosk, rooftop solar panels. Knobs: glass tint and accent stripe via roles, tower heights, time (lit office windows at night), seed. price 10

Oasis Town kit: an isometric short bakery street diorama matching oasis-town.mjs: a bakery with a big window display of breads, a flower shop with buckets of flowers, a bookshop, a post box, cobblestone pavement pattern. Knobs: shopfront colours via roles, season, time, number of shops, seed. price 9

Oasis Town kit: an isometric tiny farm diorama matching oasis-town.mjs: a red barn, a silo, crop rows of cubic plants, a fence, hay bales, a tractor. Knobs: barn colour (primary role), crop colours by season, time, field rows, seed. price 8

Oasis Town kit: an isometric winter ski lodge diorama matching oasis-town.mjs: a timber lodge with a snowy roof and chimney smoke cubes, pine trees, a ski lift pylon with chairs, skis on a rack, snow drifts. Knobs: lodge trim colour via roles, season (winter default but supports others), time with lit windows, tree density, seed. price 9
